verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents official client libraries that, once installed and configured, automatically report errors. The evidence shows libraries across several ecosystems: a Ruby gem with its own reference docs and CLI, JS packages with automatic HTTP instrumentation, and a Python Oban integration. A community user also praises the Capistrano deploy integration. Missing for 10: a documented full list of supported languages and SDK reference depth, an official SDK for the read/management API (no OpenAPI spec was found to generate one), and broader independent hands-on corroboration of the SDKs.
